basic_details.short_information: Andaman and Nicobar Islands Integrated Development Corporation Limited (ANIIDCO) has announced 1 vacancy for the Consultant (Public Relations Officer) post on a contract basis for 2026. Eligible candidates must download the application format from the website, fill in the required details, attach copies of educational qualification, experience certificates, 10th pass certificate as age proof, and two passport-size photographs, and send the application by email latest by 25 October 2026. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 50,000 per month. Candidates must hold a Graduate in Political Science/

qualification.details: Educational Qualification: Graduate in Political Science/Public Administration with a minimum of 03 (three) years of post-qualification experience in Public Administration, Government Liaison, Protocol and VIP Coordination, Event Coordination, Official Communication and private secretary work. Experience in handling official correspondence, public relations, Private Secretary work and computer knowledge is required. Age Limit: Below 35 years. Crucial date for determining age and eligibility is the last date prescribed for receipt of applications (25/10/2026).

selection_process: ANIIDCO reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the interview based on higher qualification and relevant experience. Teaching
and Freelancing shall not be considered as experience. The selection is subject to verification of documents relating to age
and other eligibility conditions before engagement. The interview will be conducted on a first-come-first-served basis
in person or through Video Conference.
important_instructions: The engagement shall initially be for a period of 01 (one) year, extendable by 01 year at a time subject to satisfactory performance and continuing requirement, up to a maximum tenure of 05 (five) years. The consultant shall perform duties assigned by the Competent Authority from time to time. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the Walk-in Interview in person. ANIIDCO reserves the right to withdraw or cancel the selection process at any stage. The number of positions/posts for consultants is subject to change as decided by the Corporation.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Interested candidates must submit their application in the prescribed format by email to [email protected] latest by 25/10/2026. Candidates are also required to bring all original certificates and documents along with two sets of biodata, self-attested copies of educational qualifications, degree/provisional certificate, 10th pass certificate for age proof, experience certificates, and two passport-size photographs to the interview or through Video Conference as decided by ANIIDCO.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Educational Qualification: Graduate in Political Science/Public Administration with a minimum of 03 (three) years of post-qualification experience in Public Administration, Government Liaison, Protocol and VIP Coordination, Event Coordination, Official Communication and private secretary work. Experience in handling official correspondence, public relations, Private Secretary work and computer knowledge is required. Age Limit: Below 35 years. Crucial date for determining age and eligibility is the last date prescribed for receipt of applications (25/10/2026).

content_sections.heading: ANIIDCO Consultant (Public Relations Officer) Job Description
content_sections.text: Responsible for Public Relations coordination Departments, preparation and dissemination of press releases, official communications and publicity material. Coordination of media interactions, meetings, events and public outreach programmes. Monitoring media coverage and maintaining media relations. Providing assistance in enhancing the public image and visibility of ANIIDCO.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application format with pasted passport-size photograph 02 (Two) sets of Biodata Self-attested copies of educational qualifications (Degree certificate / provisional certificate) 10th pass certificate (Age Proof) Experience certificate(s) Two additional copies of passport-size photographs

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: ANIIDCO reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the interview based on higher qualification and relevant experience. Teaching, Part-time, Intern, Self-employment, and Freelancing shall not be considered as experience. The selection is subject to verification of documents relating to age, educational qualification, experience, and other eligibility conditions before engagement. The interview will be conducted on a first-come-first-served basis, in person or through Video Conference.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement shall initially be for a period of 01 (one) year, extendable by 01 year at a time subject to satisfactory performance and continuing requirement, up to a maximum tenure of 05 (five) years. The consultant shall perform duties assigned by the Competent Authority from time to time. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the Walk-in Interview in person. ANIIDCO reserves the right to withdraw or cancel the selection process at any stage. The number of positions/posts for consultants is subject to change as decided by the Corporation.

faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by email is 25/10/2026.

faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Public Relations Officer) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly consultancy fee for the Public Relations Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consultancy fee of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in Political Science or Public Administration with a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years as of the last date prescribed for receipt of applications.

faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 28.10.2026 at 10.00 AM.

faq.answer: The engagement is on a contract basis initially for a period of 01 year, extendable up to a maximum tenure of 05 years.
